component.name: Multron Download Manager
component.summary: Fast multi-connection download manager with media and BitTorrent support

description.p: Multron Download Manager is a cross-platform desktop download manager built with Rust and Tauri. It accelerates file downloads using multi-connection segmentation and integrates media downloading and BitTorrent capabilities in a modern interface.

ul.li: Multi-connection segmented downloads for maximum speed
Built-in media extraction support via yt-dlp
Browser extension support for catching downloads

screenshot.caption: Main downloads view with multi-connection segment progress
Built-in file integrity and security verification

description.p: No CPU use while the window is idle or in the tray, less memory in the tray and looping effects off by default. The browser extension now catches video and audio streams from the page, and its video download button stays on the video instead of covering menus and pop-ups.

The first full release. LinkGrabber finds every file on a page, archives are extracted by themselves, and downloads can be scheduled, limited per site and sent through Tor. Also new: RSS feed search with built-in feeds, VirusTotal, statistics, a download history, automatic backups and a refreshed interface with adjustable colors and animations.
Every video quality up to 12K with its size, more audio and video formats, faster YouTube downloads and a video download button that can be moved.
Faster downloads when a server or a connection slows down, full-speed YouTube downloads and steady video progress.
